chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:

Whoever visits the grave of al-Husayn ibn 'Ali, peace be upon him, his sins will be made into a bridge at the door of his house; then he will cross over it, just as one of you leaves the bridge behind him when he crosses it.

key_terms.الْحُسَيْنِ: Imam al-Husayn عليه السلام, grandson of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.جِسْرًا: a bridge, used here as an image of passing beyond sins
key_terms.ذُنُوبُهُ: his sins or acts of disobedience
key_terms.قَبْرَ: the grave or burial place being visited

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the grave of Imam al-Husayn عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith extols the reward of visiting the grave of Imam al-Husayn عليه السلام. It describes, in vivid imagery, that the visitor's sins are left behind and crossed over, emphasizing divine forgiveness and the spiritual merit of this visitation.
